title: docs(fields): name radio as the arity exception in the MULTI_VALUE_FORM_TYPES docblock
body:
Part of objectui#4015 — deliberately **not** a closing keyword: #4015 is the maintainer's
designated decision anchor for the 2026-08-22 ruling and stays open until the producer-side
refusal lands.

## What this changes

One docblock in `packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts`. Comment-only: 19 comment lines
added, 3 rewritten, zero statements touched. `MULTI_VALUE_FORM_TYPES`' membership and every
runtime behaviour are untouched, and `RadioField.tsx` is not edited.

**Before** (:30-32) — false:

> `radio` on the select branch and `user` storing like `lookup` — but **every other member
> renders both arities INSIDE one widget**: `LookupField`, `FileField` and `ImageField` …

`radio` is omitted from that enumeration, so the sentence implies radio branches on arity
internally. It does not: `RadioField` reads `multiple` **nowhere**, which makes radio the one
`MULTI_CAPABLE_TYPES` member with no multi-arity renderer at all.

**After** — the exception is named, and pinned to evidence rather than to a promise: this
repo's own emitted value-shape contract declares `radio` with `cardinality: 'scalar'`
(`@object-ui/app-shell`'s `PARAM_VALUE_SHAPES`, drift-tested in `paramValueShape.test.ts`),
so a multi-value rendering would emit `string[]` where that contract says `string`. The
producer-side refusal is tracked in objectstack-ai/objectstack#11437 — **filed, not landed**.

## Which measurement decided the shape

Not a measurement of mine in the end: **the fork was already ruled.** Maintainer ruling of
2026-08-22 on #4015, quoted:

> **Ruled:** Option C — reject at the entrance: refuse `radio + multiple: true` at the
> schema/publish layer with a diagnostic prescribing the correctly-named multi-choice types
> (`checkboxes`/`multiselect`/`tags`) […] Option A (rendering the combination as checkboxes)
> is explicitly not taken. […] The implementation lands on the spec side (objectstack,
> `domain:spec` lane). […] The `field-type-alias.ts:28-37` comment omission of `radio` is
> corrected by the landing fork.

This PR is that named correction, and nothing else. The two measurements the dispatch ordered
were run anyway, and both agree with the ruling:

1. **The `MULTI_VALUE_FORM_TYPES` docblock does not settle radio's arity** — it explains why
   the *table* is narrow (only `select` needs a distinct widget id, for an IDREF/`labelling`
   reason) and then asserts the false sentence above. It records a false premise, not a
   decision. What does rule out a checkbox rendering in this repo is `paramValueShape.ts:142`
   plus its drift test at `paramValueShape.test.ts:93`.
2. **Occurrence of `{ type: 'radio', multiple: true }` in real metadata: zero.** Both repos
   walked — 10,977 files scanned, **21** `type: 'radio'` declarations found (control probe,
   so a broken scan cannot read as zero), **0** carrying `multiple: true`.

⛔ Option A (render the combination as checkboxes) is explicitly not taken here, and no
render-time diagnostic is added: with the shape refused at the entrance it would ship with no
measured consumer, and a `console.warn` fires in a viewer's browser rather than in the
authoring loop an AI metadata author actually runs.

## Verification — union re-run after the final commit, at `10b763b2d`

| Leg | Verdict line quoted from the tool |
|---|---|
| deps closure build | `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 53s · waited 0s` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` | `TYPECHECK_EXIT=0`, script echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.multiple.test.ts` | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 10 passed (10)` |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `✅ 1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` … `Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing` |
| `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | `✅ No changeset declares a 'major' bump.` |
| `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` | `✅ All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.` |
| `check-control-bytes.mjs` | `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 4909 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields lint` | `LINT_EXIT=0` · `✖ 870 problems (0 errors, 870 warnings)` — the warnings are the package's pre-existing baseline across 152 files; the changed file itself reports **0 errors, 0 warnings** |

Every exit code was captured **before** any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`), and each row
quotes the tool's own verdict line rather than a bare `$?`.

**No ablation is available and none was staged.** The diff is comment-only: there is no
behaviour to mutate, and deleting the prose would leave every gate green by construction. The
substitute evidence is that the new sentence is *true*: `grep -c multiple
packages/fields/src/widgets/RadioField.tsx` → **0** with control probe
`grep -cE 'RadioGroup|value'` → **23** (so a mis-pathed grep cannot read as zero), against
`LookupField` 20, `FileField` 16, `ImageField` 7, and `UserField` inheriting the branch by
delegating to `LookupField`.

**Declared narrowing.** Lint was run as the affected package's own full gate
(`eslint .` inside `packages/fields`), not the repo farm — CI runs the farm exactly once
regardless. The changed file is inside eslint's own population (a single-file `--format json`
run returns 1 result entry for it, not an ignore), and the flat config sets no
`parserOptions.project`/`projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and a comment-only
edit in one file cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

**Two environment notes for the reviewer:** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` does not exist in
this repo, so heavy legs went through the container-global entry point of the same name in the
sibling checkout (`/tmp/os-heavy-verify.lock`) rather than a hand-rolled `flock`; and no
`doc-version-claims` gate exists here — the underlying rule was honoured directly (the prose
carries no version literal).
